Food Safety Guidelines for Storing Leftovers from a Large Family Dinner

Handling and Storage:
- Refrigerate leftovers within two hours of cooking to prevent bacterial growth.
- Divide large portions of food into smaller amounts to ensure they cool more rapidly.
- Store the food in shallow containers, which allow for faster and more even cooling in the refrigerator.

Cooking and Reheating:
- When reheating leftovers, ensure they reach an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) before serving to kill any potential bacteria.
